title: Frontend resource
description: The pages of a resource in a frontend app: data (lib/<plural>.ts), actions, list, detail, form and the sidebar link, synced with the contract.

name.description: Resource name, singular or plural (e.g. invoice).

app.description: Frontend app the pages go into (apps/<app>).

lib.description: Frontend lib (packages/frontend/<lib>, created if missing) the code goes into; the route pages stay in the app. Without it: where the resource already is, else the app.

icon.description: lucide-react icon for the sidebar and the empty list (e.g. ReceiptIcon).

section.description: Sidebar section, created if missing (default CRM, or Admin with admin).

admin.description: Put the link in an admin-only section.
